## Description

Describe the changes proposed in this pull request and the motivation behind them.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature or runtime adapter (non-breaking addition)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / Refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding standards and style guidelines.
- [ ] I have verified that all unit tests pass locally (`go test ./...`).
- [ ] Overall statement test coverage is maintained at or above **95.0%**.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (`README.md`, specs, examples).
- [ ] No application code modification is required (Zero-Code principle preserved).
